title: Security review — plan, methodology & handover (Platform K)
description:
> **This issue is the coordination hub and living plan for the Platform K security review.** It holds the scope, threat model, methodology, the index of review work-streams, the evidence-cited findings register, remediation sequencing, and full handover context so anyone can pick this up cold. Modelled on the Platform S plan [PS-175](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-175).
>
> **v1 — grounded 2026-07-21 against** `develop` **@** `fcf2d878c` (161 commits since 2026-07-01). Register built from a 6-stream parallel recon (A–F); each finding cites `file:line` under `Blockchain/Dev/` on develop.

## 1. Target & threat context

* **System:** platform-k = the Secuura Cardano/blockchain anchoring platform. Node.js microservices monorepo (28 backend services: api-gateway, auth, originate, anchoring, timestamping, kyc, billing, analytics, m365-integration, tenant-provisioning, wallet-connector, nft-certificate, vc-issuer, security, governance, guardian, etc.), PostgreSQL/Prisma + RLS, Redis, Aiken smart contracts on Cardano, three React frontends (Issuer/Verifier/Admin) + Outlook/Gmail add-ins.
* **Code:** `Distributed_Secuura`, remote `github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura.git`, branch `develop`. Platform under `Blockchain/Dev/`.
* **Live env (2026-07-08,** [KS-414](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-414/demo-env-cost-pivot-replace-container-apps-with-a-single-vm-running)): single Azure VM — Caddy auto-TLS → compose nginx gateway (`nginx-demo.conf`) at `https://demo-pk.secuura.net`. The Container Apps template + hardened `nginx-production.conf` are **decommissioned/unused**. **⚠ v1 claimed** `SIMULATE_ANCHORING=true` **in the demo. That is FALSE (corrected 2026-08-13).** The demo does **real** Cardano `preview`-testnet anchoring: `SIMULATE_ANCHORING` is unset, `BLOCKFROST_API_KEY` is set, anchoring boots `cardanoMode: REAL (Blockfrost)`, and a funded **platform wallet mnemonic is present on the VM**. Treat the anchoring path on the live target as a live chain-submission path with key material, not a simulation — see the re-grounding comment (2026-08-13) and KS-535 / KS-607.
* **Integrations:** platform-s (SSD document platform, the S↔K channel — K is the server), Stripe (billing), Microsoft 365 / Entra Verified-ID (KYC/IDV), M365 Graph (Outlook/Gmail add-ins), Cardano (Blockfrost).
* **Protects:** legally-significant artefacts (on-chain anchors, timestamps, VCs/NFTs, document hashes), PII, org/tenant data, payment flows, per-tenant connector credentials.
* **Threat assumptions:** millions of users, high public profile, under continuous attack. Treat availability, tenant isolation, and **anchor/signature integrity** as first-order.

## 2. Objectives

1. Evidence-cited findings register (`file:line`, severity) across the whole attack surface — kept current with develop.
2. Prioritised, **sequenced** remediation issues with owners and acceptance criteria (see §5).
3. Strategic hardening for scale — WAF, bot/anti-automation, edge rate-limits/body-caps, secret manager at runtime, DDoS protection, observability/alerting.
4. Repeatable security gates (make the report-only CI scans blocking; keep the [KS-470](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-470/npm-audit-25-transitive-advisories-on-the-develop-lockfile) audit-gate + lockfile clean-room green) so posture doesn't regress.
5. A **security regression test** for every confirmed finding, in the right harness (systemTest — schemathesis / Akto / cross-tenant-isolation / Playwright).

## 3. Scope & review work-streams

Recon streams A–F are **complete** (this v1 pass). Work-stream owners: **Kamil** for A–F + H; **Peter** for G (systemTest).

> **Table amended 2026-08-13** — the v1 table showed six streams all reading "Recon done", which had drifted from the board in both directions and **omitted Review H entirely** (created by comment on 2026-07-21, closed 2026-08-02). A wrong index costs every future reader. `Status` below is the live Linear state; `Recon` records whether the v1 recon pass covered it.

| \# | Work-stream | Issue | Owner | Recon | Status (live 2026-08-13) |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| A | AuthN / AuthZ / tenancy & IDOR | [KS-486](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-486) | Kamil | done | **In Review** |
| B | Input validation, injection, upload, XSS/SSRF & crypto | [KS-487](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-487) | Kamil | done | Todo |
| C | S↔K channel, payments/webhooks & integrations (M365 / KYC / wallet / email) | [KS-488](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-488) | Kamil | done | Todo |
| D | Blockchain / anchoring / smart-contract integrity | [KS-489](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-489) | Kamil | done | **In Review** |
| E | Deployment, containers & CI/CD supply chain | [KS-490](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-490) | Kamil | done | Todo |
| F | Edge, WAF, DDoS & anti-automation | [KS-491](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-491) | Kamil | done | **Todo — IN PROGRESS 2026-08-13** (untouched 07-21 → 08-13) |
| **G** | **systemTest security regression coverage** | [KS-492](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-492) | **Peter** | n/a | Standing (Todo) |

**Deferred as its own sequenced pass:** re-recon of streams A–F against the 168 commits / 202 changed files landed since v1's baseline `fcf2d878c`. Tracked as [KS-612](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-612) (child of this issue) — this re-grounding refreshed the *plan*, not the findings.

## 4. Methodology

Recon → findings register (severity-rated, evidence-cited, mapped loosely to OWASP ASVS / Top 10) → triage (severity × exploitability × blast-radius-at-scale) → sequenced remediation issues with acceptance criteria → verification (reproduce pre-fix, confirm blocked post-fix, add a systemTest regression). **Re-ground the register against develop whenever the branch has materially moved** (the [PS-175](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-175/security-review-plan-methodology-and-handover-platform-s) v2 pass is the template).

## 5. Findings register + remediation sequencing

**Legend:** Sev = severity as found on develop @ `fcf2d878c`. All rows cite `Blockchain/Dev/…`. Full evidence + GREEN notes live on each work-stream issue.

### A — AuthN / AuthZ / tenancy & IDOR — [KS-486](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-486)

| Sev | file:line | Finding |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Med | `services/api-gateway/src/routes/notifications.ts:242-272` | `POST /api/notifications` takes `userId` from body, no self/admin check → spoofed `security`/`system` notifications w/ `actionUrl` to anyone (in-app phishing / BOLA). |
| Med | `services/originate/src/repositories/documentRepo.ts:173-205`; transfer `routes/documents.ts:1318` | Documents scoped by `tenant_id` only, never `owner_user_id` — any user in a tenant can read/mutate/transfer another user's doc. Confirm intended tenant==org boundary. |
| Med | `services/originate/src/index.ts:220-227`; `routes/documents.ts:131-133` | Tenant scope derived from inbound `x-tenant-id`; originate JWT has no `tenantId` to cross-check → pure header trust. Safe only via gateway strip + RLS; header-forwarding/SSRF re-opens [KS-4](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-4/critical-cross-tenant-document-leak-via-x-tenant-override-bug)-class cross-tenant read. |
| Low | `services/auth/src/routes/mfa.ts:225-236` | `mfa/verify` validates TOTP with no proof factor-1 passed (standalone TOTP oracle; issues no tokens). |
| Low | gateway `middleware/auth.ts:106-150` vs auth `middleware/authenticate.ts:19-65` | `test_token_*` backdoor guarded asymmetrically — one mis-set env = role/tenant spoof. |

### B — Input validation, injection, upload, XSS/SSRF & crypto — [KS-487](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-487)

| Sev | file:line | Finding |
| -- | -- | -- |
| High | `services/m365-integration/src/index.ts:1072,1202` | Teams `webhookUrl` validated only by `z.string().url()` — no SSRF guard; `fetch()` to `169.254.169.254`/RFC1918/localhost. |
| Med | `services/originate/src/routes/webhooks.ts:153-205,455-490` | `validateWebhookUrl` blocks only IP literals (no DNS resolution → DNS-rebind) and only at registration, not send time. |
| Med | `services/originate/src/routes/adminConfig.ts:1769-1773` (+`:36`) | `POST /api/admin/seed-demo-users` mints ORG_ADMIN/OWNER w/ hardcoded `admin123`; no `NODE_ENV`/`ENABLE_DEMO_SEED` gate. |
| Med | `services/kyc/src/index.ts:251` | ID images stored from caller-supplied `mimeType`, no magic-byte verification. |
| Low | `frontend/outlook-addin/src/taskpane/index.tsx:60` | `el.innerHTML` interpolates `${e.message}` — unescaped sink (error path). |

### C — S↔K channel, payments/webhooks & integrations — [KS-488](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-488)

| Sev | file:line | Finding |
| -- | -- | -- |
| High | `services/kyc/src/routes/microsoft-verification.ts:201` | Callback authed by static `api-key` w/ hardcoded default `'secuura-kyc-callback'` → forge Entra Verified-ID results. |
| High | `services/wallet-connector/src/server.ts:246-259` | `POST /api/wallets/verify` is a stub — always `verified:true`. Wallet-ownership proof fully bypassable. |
| Med | `services/m365-integration/src/index.ts:138-161,235-243` | Graph access+refresh tokens persisted to Postgres in plaintext. |
| Med | `services/billing/src/routes/webhooks.ts:34-37` | `isEventProcessed` fails **open** on DB-unavailable → redelivered Stripe event re-adds credits. |
| Low | `services/auth/src/services/email.ts:40-45,148-149` | No CRLF sanitisation on `documentTitle`→`subject`; no recipient-domain allow-list. |
| Low | `frontend/gmail-addon/Code.gs:17-18` | Hardcoded to decommissioned Container Apps URLs (stale). |

### D — Blockchain / anchoring / smart-contract integrity — [KS-489](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-489)

| Sev | file:line | Finding |
| -- | -- | -- |
| High | `services/originate/src/routes/documents.ts:582-593` | On anchoring-POST failure with `SIMULATE_ANCHORING` unset (**default**), fabricates `tx_sim_…` + `status:'anchored'` — outage → fake anchored doc. No `NODE_ENV` guard. |
| Med | `services/timestamping/src/tsa/qualified-tsa.ts:305-325` | TSA error/timeout → `success:true` self-generated `mock:true` token for eIDAS/UETA artefacts. |
| Med | `services/anchoring/src/cardano/confirmation.ts:38-50` | First non-null Blockfrost `getTransaction` → `confirmed:true`; no finality threshold. |
| Med | `services/anchoring/src/index.ts:982-1041` | `verify` derives `verified:true` from local DB row only; single anchors get no chain re-fetch/hash compare. |

### E — Deployment, containers & CI/CD supply chain — [KS-490](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-490)

| Sev | file:line | Finding |
| -- | -- | -- |
| High | `Blockchain/Dev/docker-compose.yml:61` (repeated) | 32-char `APP_DB_PASSWORD` literal committed as `:-default` across **51** conn strings — `grep -c 'APP_DB_PASSWORD:-' Blockchain/Dev/docker-compose.yml` at the grounding SHA `fcf2d878c` **and** at develop `87384a8ba` (2026-09-06); the original "\~20" was wrong when written, not drifted. See comment `ef553d29`. |
| High | `.github/workflows/security-scan.yml:99,112,134,138,272,298` | Trivy/Gitleaks/Semgrep/Checkov all `continue-on-error` → report-only, can't block a merge. |
| Med | `.github/workflows/deploy-demo.yml:365-366,369,377` | KV secrets → `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` unmasked + inlined into `DATABASE_URL`. |
| Med | `Blockchain/Dev/docker-compose.yml:64,119` | Postgres (`:6432`) + Redis (`:6379`) publish to host by default. |
| Med | root `package-lock.json` axios 1.16.1; kyc 1.15.2; mobile 1.13.2 | Stale-lock axios drift vs 1.18.1 (other advisories already patched — axios is the only live drift). [KS-420](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-420/dependency-and-tooling-version-hygiene-audit-from-clean-rebuild) #6. |
| Low | all `services/*/Dockerfile`, `frontend/*` | Base images tag- not digest-pinned; `auth/Dockerfile:46` ships build tooling in runtime layer. |

### F — Edge, WAF, DDoS & anti-automation — [KS-491](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-491)

| Sev | Evidence | Finding |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Crit (strategic) | repo-wide absent; `deployment/DEPLOYMENT-ARCHITECTURE.md:50` | **No WAF** anywhere (Cloudflare DNS-only). Product owner wants WAF — greenfield. |
| High | `docker/nginx-gateway/nginx-demo.conf` | Live gateway has no `limit_req`/`client_max_body_size`; hardened `nginx-production.conf` is decommissioned-path only. |
| High | Caddyfile absent from repo | Real TLS edge (Caddy on VM) not version-controlled. |
| High | repo-wide absent | No CAPTCHA/Turnstile on signup/login/verify. |
| Med | `services/api-gateway/src/middleware/rateLimitEnforce.ts:135-137` | App-tier limiters fail **open** on Redis error ([KS-170](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-170/enforceclientratelimit-runs-in-memory-per-replica-wire-the-redis)). |
| Med | `nginx-demo.conf` | No Slowloris/large-body/slow-request protection at the live edge. |

### Remediation sequencing (amplifier-first)

* **Wave 1 — active exposure + one-liners:** ungated `seed-demo-users` (B), KYC callback default-secret (C), wallet-verify stub (C), committed `APP_DB_PASSWORD` + lock pg/redis to internal (E/F), make CI scan gates blocking (E).
* **Wave 2 — integrity criticals (K's crown jewels):** anchor-fabrication-on-outage + `NODE_ENV` guard (D), qualified-TSA mock fallback (D), verify-against-chain not DB (D), finality threshold (D), m365 SSRF + originate webhook DNS-rebind/send-time revalidation (B).
* **Wave 3 — authz/tenancy hardening:** notification BOLA (A), document owner-scoping decision + fix (A), close header-trust tenancy path / add JWT `tenantId` cross-check (A), M365 token encryption at rest (C), billing idempotency fail-closed (C).
* **Wave 4 — edge & strategic (scale):** WAF at the edge (F), bot/anti-automation (F), version-control the Caddy edge + port `nginx-production.conf` rate-limits/body-caps/headers to the live conf (F/E), runtime secret manager on the VM (E), observability/alerting (F).
* **Wave 5 — hygiene backlog:** axios lockfile regen (E, [KS-420](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-420/dependency-and-tooling-version-hygiene-audit-from-clean-rebuild) #6), digest-pin base images + drop build tooling from auth runtime (E), MFA-verify factor-1 binding + test-token env symmetry (A), email CRLF/allow-list + gmail-addon dead URLs (C).

## 6. Handover / continuity

* **Grounded against** `develop` @ `fcf2d878c` (2026-07-21). All findings cite `file:line` under `Blockchain/Dev/`.
* **Owners:** Kamil (A–F remediation); Peter (G / all systemTest security work — per project convention).
* **Live env reality:** the demo runs on a single VM (Caddy → `nginx-demo.conf`), **not** the Container Apps template — treat `nginx-production.conf` as an unused hardening template, not today's edge. See `Blockchain/Dev/deployment/DEPLOYMENT-ARCHITECTURE.md`.
* **Related tickets/programs:** [KS-201](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-201/enforce-utc-for-all-datetime-handling-across-backend-services-and) (UTC), [KS-240](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-240/strict-by-default-on-chain-minimisation-strip-issuername-any-human) (on-chain PII-min), [KS-470](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-470/npm-audit-25-transitive-advisories-on-the-develop-lockfile) (npm-audit gate), [KS-420](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-420/dependency-and-tooling-version-hygiene-audit-from-clean-rebuild) [Secuura/Distributed_Secuura#6](https://linear.app/secuura/review/openapi-track-2-ks-2-demo-deploy-hardening-verifier-fixes-035a046e49aa) (lockfile drift), [KS-384](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-384/lockfiles-gate-blind-spot-manifest-only-dependency-bumps-the) (lockfiles-gate blind spot), [KS-4](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-4/critical-cross-tenant-document-leak-via-x-tenant-override-bug) (historical cross-tenant leak — see A header-trust residual), [KS-170](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-170/enforceclientratelimit-runs-in-memory-per-replica-wire-the-redis) (rate-limit fail-open), [KS-258](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-258/testschemathesis-add-gdpr-idor-ownership-guard-regression-tests-ks-228)/[KS-268](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-268/localdev-coverage-for-503-by-design-integration-endpoints-billing) (schemathesis security checks), [KS-263](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-263/enable-code-security-ghas-so-security-scans-populate-the-security-tab) (enable GHAS), and the Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration — cross-reference where crypto/auth findings overlap. Cross-boundary trust with platform-s is covered from S's side in [PS-178](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-178). **S↔K data-loss / unrecoverability register:** [KS-533](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-533/sk-security-register-data-loss-unrecoverability-scenarios-code) (18 likelihood-rated rows from the [KS-480](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-480/sk-k-side-support-consistent-userorg-ownership-credential) sign-off) — **closed Done 2026-09-14**, every row dispositioned to an owner ticket; see the closure comment on this issue dated 2026-09-14. K-side residue: [KS-532](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-532/sk-dr-k-side-key-store-restore-path-joint-restore-point-coverage-demo) (DR rows #8/#14/#18, Kam), [KS-581](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-581/register-connector-volume-alerting-rate-limit-and-correlation-of) (row #15 — `externalRef` GUID validation + env-scoped provisioning creds, Kam), [KS-568](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-568/systemtest-schemathesis-sk-connector-identity-regression-coverage-ks) (rows #16/#17 systemTest regression, Peter, blocked on [KS-516](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-516/schemathesis-systemtest-seed-a-real-sk-api-key-documentswrite-so-the)).
* **Test harness for verification (G):** `systemTest/schemathesis` (custom checks incl. GDPR/IDOR ownership guard + 5xx guard), `systemTest/akto` (OWASP scan), `systemTest/cross-tenant-isolation` (IDOR repro), `systemTest/playwright`, spec-auth conformance in `scripts/preflight/preflight.sh`.

**Status:** recon complete (A–F, v1); register grounded to develop; work-stream issues [KS-486](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-486/review-a-authn-authz-tenancy-and-idor)…[KS-492](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-492/review-g-systemtest-security-regression-coverage) filed with pre-seeded findings; remediation not yet started — sequenced above.

* Swap windows on Kintsugi: transfer 22:00:27 to 22:00:36 AEDT (image b3634e8f322c to a080c05233fd); api-gateway 22:00:36 to 22:00:48 AEDT (image cd822bbb39ed to 00252e3ca567). Both healthy afterwards, restarts 0. The build rebuilt 2 images and left 31 unchanged.

Two consumer-visible changes: the anchor retry route now checks role, document access and revoked state, and the NFT certificate list is bound to the verified caller (today it returns an empty list for real callers, see below). Update your local at your convenience.

**What shipped**

- **Commit:** develop `e3d8456ec81d0b02172dd5a3060404815e797bde` (#1819's squash), four PRs on top of `429ba4824915`: #1817, #1814, #1818, #1819.
- **Envs:** **kintsugi** deployed 2026-10-30 09:59:52 AEDT (2026-10-29 22:59:52 UTC), **demo-pk** deployed 10:32:01 AEDT (23:32:01 UTC).
- **Traffic:** two services were recreated one at a time on each box, originate then nft-certificate. kintsugi 09:59:15-09:59:52 AEDT (22:59:15-22:59:52 UTC), demo-pk 10:31:22-10:32:01 AEDT (23:31:22-23:32:01 UTC). Calls through those two services were briefly unavailable in those windows. anchoring, api-gateway, auth, mcp-server, postgres and every other service were not restarted.

**What changed**

- **#1814 (KS-1814, with KS-1829's comment fix):** `POST /api/documents/:id/anchor` (the re-anchor route) now answers **403** to a caller without a document-write role or the `documents:write` scope; **404**, exactly as for an absent document, to a caller who is not a platform admin, the document's owner or the connector that created it; and **400** for a revoked or deleted document. The status write after anchoring now preserves terminal statuses, so a revoke that lands while an anchor is in flight is no longer overwritten with `anchored`.
- **A same-organisation company admin who is not the owner is refused (404) by #1814 in this round.** The company-admin and transfer-custody rule is a follow-up Kam ruled on 2026-10-30: it comes only if the rights set at the time of creation allow it. It is not in this deploy.
- **#1819 (KS-1836):** `GET /api/nft/certificates` takes the owner from the verified caller, never from `?userId=`. `?userId=` and `?walletAddress=` can only narrow the caller's own rows; a foreign selector gets the same empty 200 as no rows, and a caller with no usable identity gets **403**.
- **Every NFT certificate recorded today carries a placeholder owner, so a real caller's list is empty until the mint paths record the owner (KS-1820).** That is the intended fail-closed reading, and it is visible to any direct API caller of the list. No frontend calls this route; one e2e fixture (`tests/e2e/tests/recruitment/fixtures/recruitment-data.ts`) names it, and no spec calls it.
